risk_if_not_implemented: Without Steering Committee & Program Oversight, security, compliance and resilience activities may lack direction, ownership and executive support, leaving required controls unperformed. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Failure to Support Business / Mission Objectives (R-GV-1), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to assign one or more qualified individuals with the mission and resources to centrally-manage, coordinate, develop, implement and maintain an enterprise-wide Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP).
compensating_control_1.justification: Assigned Security, Compliance & Resilience Responsibilities (GOV-05) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Steering Committee & Program Oversight (GOV-09) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Management Program
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of strategic, operational and tactical risk management controls that are aligned with:
(1) The organization's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM); and
(2) Industry-recognized cybersecurity risk management practices.
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Management Program (RSK-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Steering Committee & Program Oversight (GOV-09) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
